## Checklist

- [ ] If a new `go-standards/references/*.md` file was added, it has a row in `go-standards/SKILL.md`'s routing table
- [ ] If a claim is version-specific, a source is cited in the PR description
- [ ] If the change is user-visible, `CHANGELOG.md` is updated
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal paths, or private project data are included
- [ ] Instruction changes in `go-standards/SKILL.md` or `go-standards/references/*.md`, and changes under `scripts/`, were diff-reviewed
- [ ] `bash scripts/structural-check.sh` completes without error
